reviewer.independence: Did not author the checker or TC unit source; implementation and tests were independently inspected.

scope: Read-only owner/query recorder audit foundation; not full per-case H2 evidence validation.

authorization.environment: Minimal PATH=/usr/bin, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; no site initialization or SDK environment.
authorization.result_capture: Private stdout/stderr, AST-derived exact28 unit IDs and source hashes before/after; timeout or any missing/extra/failing unit prevents unit-result acceptance.
authorization.only_inputs: The two exact source pins and synthetic files owned by unittest TemporaryDirectory fixtures; stdlib imports only.
authorization.source_change_rule: Any source-pin or discovery-scope change requires a new scoped source review before execution.

resolved_finding.issue: The initial root lstat could escape as an OSError containing the private absolute path if the root disappeared after resolution.
resolved_finding.resolution: Root lstat now shares the fixed PRIVATE_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE error boundary. Verified in the pinned source; no dynamic race test was executed.

evidence: The checker imports stdlib only, opens evidence read-only, checks root resolution/identity, opens child directories relative to trusted descriptors with no-follow, and requires current-user mode0700 directories and regular mode0600 single-link files.

Per-file reads are size-bounded and compare descriptor identity, mode, link count, size and timestamps before/after reading; the returned manifest hashes the actual bytes read. Descriptors close on all inspected paths.

JSON decoding rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite values, malformed encoding and unsupported canonical values. Exact node/pytest phase, positive observation time, filename timestamp and caller shape are checked before counting.
Owner snapshots require the original raw fields and producer row widths: accepted23, bindings27, scopes6, receipts9 and attempts5. The canonical SHA256 recipe matches the actual unchanged producer.
Queries require the actual result field, operation and subject. Empty and null results remain valid raw observations; operation-specific result semantics are deliberately outside this foundation.

Counts belong to each exact node and operation; another known node cannot satisfy minima. Canonically identical copied records cannot inflate counts. Invalid/duplicate requirements and inconsistent min/max bounds fail closed.

All28 TC methods use synthetic TemporaryDirectory files and import only stdlib plus this checker. They check positive owner/query manifests, phases, empty/null results, missing/cross-node records, digest/shape/duplicate/count errors, JSON failures, filename/size/mode errors and symlink/hardlink rejection with exact error codes.
risks_and_edge_cases: This foundation does not freeze the whole directory namespace or certify completeness under concurrent additions, renames or replacement. A later runtime integration must operate on quiescent preserved evidence and review its archive/namespace integrity separately.

Canonical duplicate detection rejects literal observation copies; changing metadata is not proof of another real invocation. Actual invocation completeness, producer causality and raw query/SQL semantics remain separate mandatory checks.

History/list/tree/process rules, the87 explicit mappings, full490 inventory/runner integration, all25 obligations and five fixture prerequisites, exact paired reviews and full-H2 pre-gates remain pending. No existing H2 producer or full runner is approved or changed by this review.
recommendation: Execute only the bounded pinned synthetic unit command and retain its actual result. Continue explicit mapping and full-runner integration through their separate reviews; do not treat these units as H2 evidence acceptance.
remaining_uncertainty: This review executed no tests. Actual unit outcomes and all runtime evidence remain unaccepted.

validation.method: Static checker/TC/producer inspection, source SHA256 and review-document JSON validation only.
